scope: focused follow-up of the commander ratings design revision

findings.summary: Alternative-candidate view defined: one refit per side and candidate, including grade D sides.
Nesting rule acts only on views containing both records; primary rows and the verdict unaffected; section 3 wording.
Improvement means strictly lower held-out log loss under both weightings.
view_sensitive counted per refit; unranked_in_view label.
Rule 5 applies rule 3 to several listings of one force (VA012 CS).
Rule 2 names whom to use when a passage contradicts the listing; registry allows passage-only officers.
Status paragraph limited to what the decision record supports.
Restored "Army quality, subordinates and supply stay in the residual."
Rule 5 overall-command passage case is grade A, as for rule 3(a).
GA004 US added to the tie examples, noting 3(a) may decide them.
Rank order declared for the strings used; Brevet and Acting ranks rank as the named rank; army and navy not compared.
Grade D rows count through alpha, and beta where the view has a force term.

design_status: accepted for implementation under the owner delegation
